title: Telegram Desktop vulnerability allowed any user's file to be stolen
summary: Security researcher discloses a critical vulnerability in Telegram Desktop that allowed attackers to steal any user's files through a one-click account takeover attack, potentially affecting millions of users.
problem_solved: Documents and remediates a severe security flaw that enabled unauthorized remote file access and account compromise in Telegram's desktop client.
why_valuable: Provides critical security research that protects user privacy and demonstrates the importance of thorough security auditing in widely-used messaging applications.
